mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, hall_id, movie_id, schedule_startTime, schedule_price, schedule_remain, schedule_state FROM schedule WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
SELECT schedule_id, hall_id, movie_id, schedule_startTime, schedule_price, schedule_remain, schedule_state FROM schedule WHERE schedule_state = #{scheduleState} ORDER BY schedule_startTime DESC
SELECT schedule_id, hall_id, movie_id, schedule_startTime, schedule_price, schedule_remain, schedule_state FROM schedule ORDER BY schedule_startTime DESC

SELECT s.schedule_id, s.hall_id, s.movie_id, s.schedule_startTime, s.schedule_price, s.schedule_remain, s.schedule_state FROM schedule s INNER JOIN hall h ON s.hall_id = h.hall_id WHERE h.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND s.movie_id = #{movieId} AND s.schedule_state = 1 ORDER BY s.schedule_startTime

SELECT s.schedule_id, s.hall_id, s.movie_id, s.schedule_startTime, s.schedule_price, s.schedule_remain, s.schedule_state FROM schedule s INNER JOIN movie m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id WHERE s.schedule_state = 1 AND m.movie_cn_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{movieName}, '%') ORDER BY s.schedule_startTime DESC

SELECT s.schedule_id, s.hall_id, s.movie_id, s.schedule_startTime, s.schedule_price, s.schedule_remain, s.schedule_state FROM schedule s INNER JOIN movie m ON s.movie_id = m.movie_id WHERE s.schedule_state = 0 AND m.movie_cn_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{movieName}, '%') ORDER BY s.schedule_startTime DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule(hall_id, movie_id, schedule_price, schedule_remain, schedule_startTime, schedule_state) VALUES(#{hallId}, #{movieId}, #{schedulePrice}, #{scheduleRemain}, #{scheduleStartTime}, 1)
mapper.update:
